text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I come across a notebook dropped by Trainer Kiryuin. It's full of detailed information to help her be a better trainer for Happy Meek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She clearly cares about Happy Meek's struggles to make progress and makes an effort to put her first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I can't shake the feeling that the two aren't quite seeing eye to eye…
